project.description: Curls the Pacemaker floating IP every 5 minutes. Logs the timestamp, serving node name, and full response to /var/log/webz/monitor.log

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash FLOATING_IP="172.20.0.100" PORT="80" LOG_FILE="/var/log/webz/monitor.log"
mkdir -p /var/log/webz
RUN_TIME=$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
HTTP_RESPONSE=$(curl -s --max-time 10 "http://${FLOATING_IP}:${PORT}") CURL_EXIT=$?
SERVING_NODE=$(echo "$HTTP_RESPONSE" | grep "Served by" | sed 's/<[^>]*>//g' | xargs)
if [ $CURL_EXIT -ne 0 ]; then echo "----------------------------------------" >> "$LOG_FILE" echo "Time : $RUN_TIME" >> "$LOG_FILE" echo "Status : FAILED (curl exit: $CURL_EXIT)" >> "$LOG_FILE" echo "Node : unreachable" >> "$LOG_FILE" echo "----------------------------------------" >> "$LOG_FILE" exit 1 fi
echo "----------------------------------------" >> "$LOG_FILE" echo "Time : $RUN_TIME" >> "$LOG_FILE" echo "Node : $SERVING_NODE" >> "$LOG_FILE" echo "Response : $HTTP_RESPONSE" >> "$LOG_FILE" echo "----------------------------------------" >> "$LOG_FILE"
echo "Logged response from: $SERVING_NODE"
